intro.TrustedMarkup:
The language of a .syntax file: the file format, std/syntax.syntax, which the toolchain's **/*.syntax row of the languages map names.

The editor reads a grammar file through this module and its companion, std/grammar.editor.vyrn, to which it exports how a grammar file names its rules: a definition starts in column 0, and its head is the name that opens the line, after an optional nest.
